name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
blurb: Card with pointer-tracked radial spotlight on border/surface.
description: A rounded container card with a cursor-tracked radial spotlight. Spotlight position updates via CSS variables on pointer move; fades out on leave.
use_when: Premium card designs or feature showcases where subtle spotlight effects add polish and draw focus to content.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where pointer tracking won't work or accessibility contexts where motion should be minimal.
a11y: Card is a semantic container; children are independent. Spotlight is visual embellishment only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
